title: Sound studio's music preview
oneLine: Off / playing(key) preview on its own <audio>, ducking the game's music bus and holding the land-music watch off.
topConcern: The duck is a one-shot gain write; a bus rebuilt after an iOS context loss brings zone music back under the preview.

title: Sound studio's way in (closed, opening, open)
oneLine: Module host/root/promise trio lazily mounting the studio once; ?sounds polls until the world is up.
topConcern: A close during the lazy import is ignored and the studio mounts anyway (test-only route).

title: Design gallery scrim latch and Escape
oneLine: Gallery over the paint panel: press-began-on-scrim latch, category filter, capture-phase Escape leaving the editor intact.

title: Test panel admin call lifecycle
oneLine: Single busy flag, message line and 12 s abort for every admin HTTP call; quiet background refresh touches neither.
topConcern: busy is a boolean, not a count: chained calls leave microtask gaps where buttons re-enable and a second action can overlap.

title: Test panel's copy of server-held toggles
oneLine: Panel snapshot of god mode, test mode and spar state; each toggle sends an absolute value derived from it.
topConcern: The snapshot never ticks and replies are unordered, so a stale snapshot (expired god mode, late quiet refresh) sends the wrong direction once.

title: Message diet modes and memory savers as live-flag chains
oneLine: Message-diet modes and memory savers set as chains of live-flag writes with no rollback.
topConcern: A chain failing half-way leaves an unpicked mode live: from kill, 'Only ?diet=1' can end with the diet on for every phone.

title: Test panel two-tap arms and once-shown key
oneLine: Armed latches for Freeze, Forget devices and New key, disarmed by editing the code or acting; new key shown once.
topConcern: Arms never expire and Forget/New key can both be armed; both name the target, so no wrong-target case found.

title: Test panel zone warp (S._devWarp)
oneLine: S._devWarp destination walked through the old map's hub doors leg by leg by driveDevWarp.
topConcern: Retired-map only; the client writes P.x/P.y; the empty Zones section still renders in the world.

title: Shared ink/brush tool store
oneLine: Module ink/brush pair shared by the creator's inline palette and the editor, mirrored by seed and write-back effects.

title: Creator's look: store and React mirrors, species rules, Randomize, Reset
oneLine: Trait picks written to sprite stores and React mirrors by tabs, species rules, Randomize's flair interval and Reset.
topConcern: Randomize's 110 ms flair interval is never cancelled: Reset inside 330 ms is overwritten; ENTER snapshots a mid-flair look into bt_resume.

title: Name entry and the Enter BroTown gate
oneLine: Press latch plus live block reason gating Enter BroTown; iOS keyboard pad from visualViewport.
topConcern: The name field's Enter checks length only, so a pinch-zoomed phone gets joinTown's alert instead of the inline reason.

title: Creator preview drag-to-rotate vs tap-to-zoom
oneLine: Pointer machine on the creator preview: 26 px drag steps the facing, a still tap toggles zoom, cue earned once.
topConcern: No pointerId tracking: a second finger resets the drag and can toggle the zoom.

title: Creator's ink card: which editor is open
oneLine: Which drawing editor is open (showPaint) and the inkRev counter that re-memoises the creator's look.
topConcern: PlayerPaint has no key; a keyboard-reached card behind the scrim swaps target without remount, writing one garment's pattern onto another.

title: Paint editor: canvas being inked, its doc and undo history
oneLine: Which of nine canvases is inked (mode, side, finger) plus its op-list doc, per-canvas undo/redo and persist effect.
topConcern: One value lives in five places updated at different moments; five recorded bugs (v2.3.1967 to v2.3.2431) were in this handshake.

title: Paint editor gesture and held piece
oneLine: Stroke, shape drag, pick-up, move and resize gestures, and the held piece's pend record with Place and Cancel.
topConcern: Cancel after a layer move unbanks nothing, so the next Undo resurrects the cancelled shape or colour.

title: WornPreview and BodyInk composite loops
oneLine: rAF-coalesced character composites for the worn preview and the inkable body: idle, scheduled, baking, dirty.
topConcern: A request made while an older effect's bake awaits images is never re-kicked; the preview stays one change behind.

title: BodyInk pointer machine (draw, pinch, pan, held grab, auto-fit)
oneLine: Pointer map, pinch record and per-gesture locked canvas on the body surface, plus pan mode and auto-fit per region.
topConcern: Three fingers start a new gesture fed by every pointer, and a stale pinch resumes on the remaining pair.

title: Character picker roster lookup loop
oneLine: Sequential per-row account lookups filling roster names, levels and looks, restarted on every roster change.
topConcern: The effect restarts after each answer while the old loop's next fetch is already sent: rows after the first are asked twice against 20/min.

title: Character picker options road (menu, typed confirm, remove/restart)
oneLine: Menu then typed-yes confirm for removing or restarting a roster row; busy blocks every exit while the restart runs.

title: Character picker portraits
oneLine: Per-row async face raster keyed on the look, discarded when the row unmounts or its look changes.

title: Dungeon Workshop pack store and saved dungeons
oneLine: Dungeon pack purchases and five saved designs held only in the client's rpg copy and the bt_rpg cache.
topConcern: Buy subtracts gold on the phone with no server message; the gold returns on the next coin update and the pack stays owned.

title: Dungeon Workshop launch: worker run vs legacy local arena
oneLine: dungeon_start request to the worker's instance, with a legacy client-only arena when caps.dungeon is missing.
topConcern: A cap-named 'dungeon: false' flag would send players into a client-only arena; the eleven run flags have two writers.

title: Sound studio view: tabs, filters, heard ticker
oneLine: Tab and filter view state plus a 500 ms re-render ticker alive only on the heard and music tabs.

title: Editor op-list store (bt-artops)
oneLine: Per-canvas op lists kept in bt-artops beside the art, flattened whenever they stop replaying to the stored drawing.
topConcern: No shape number: a newer op kind read by an older client silently loses its shapes (pixels kept).

title: Trait picker 'more below' cues
oneLine: Two derived scroll flags re-measured on scroll, tab and pick changes, and by one ResizeObserver.

title: Dungeon Workshop design being edited
oneLine: In-memory Workshop design and tab; the waves slider shows a clamped value while the stored config keeps the larger one.
topConcern: Default 3 waves shows as 2 below level 10 and fails validation, disabling Play with no visible cause.
